Name: Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio
DetectionPattern: C:\Program Files\Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio 22\Release\Common7\IDE\SSMS.exe
InstallCmd:
$vswhere = "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
$installPath = 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio 22\Release'
$verb = if ((Test-Path $vswhere) -and (& $vswhere -products * -path $installPath -property installationVersion 2>$null)) { 'update' } else { 'install' }
Start-ADTProcess -FilePath 'vs_SSMS.exe' -ArgumentList "$verb --installPath `"$installPath`" --noWeb --quiet --norestart --wait" -WindowStyle 'Hidden'
UninstallCmd: Start-ADTProcess -FilePath "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\setup.exe" -ArgumentList 'uninstall --installPath "C:\Program Files\Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio 22\Release" --quiet'  -WindowStyle 'Hidden'
